# Fieldkit: awesome OSINT tools for Windows
A curated list of the Fieldkit family — open-source intelligence tools for Windows 10/11,
one for every kind of clue: a nickname, a photo, a domain, a wallet, a company.
Public data only, no accounts, portable builds.
## The list
- **Acid Test** — Check a shop or site before you pay — 23 checks, one plain answer. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/acid-test) `site-checker`
- **Aka** — Every public mention of a nickname, year by year, back to the first one. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/aka) `username-search`
- **Amber** — Web archive viewer that shows what a page removed. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/amber) `web-archive`
- **Assay** — Crypto address reputation: sanctions, mixers, theft reports in one score. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/assay) `crypto-aml`
- **Azimuth** — Find where a photo or video was taken from shadows, signs, skylines. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/azimuth) `geolocation`
- **Domesday** — Public asset and property records for due diligence. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/domesday) `asset-records`
- **Exposure** — See what the internet has on you, then close each trace. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/exposure) `digital-footprint`
- **Gazette** — Company and officer search across public registers of many countries. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/gazette) `company-search`
- **Interchange** — Follow crypto across chains and name every bridge on the route. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/interchange) `cross-chain`
- **Legwork** — AI investigator that answers with a source on every sentence. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/legwork) `ai-investigator`
- **Loupe** — Check if a photo or video is edited, recycled or AI-made. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/loupe) `image-verification`
- **Mutuals** — See how two accounts are connected, ranked by closeness. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/mutuals) `social-graph`
- **Namesake** — Find the right person behind a shared name. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/namesake) `people-search`
- **Pegboard** — One clue in, a finished OSINT case out — the family runner. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/pegboard) `toolkit`
- **Playtime** — A nickname's gaming profiles and hours on one shelf. · [download](https://awesomeosint.tools/playtime) `gaming-profiles`

top10.descricao_en: AI OSINT investigator for Windows: ask a question in plain words and get an answer built from public sources, with a source on every sentence.
top10.readme:
Legwork: OSINT AI investigator that cites its sources 
  You ask. It does the legwork.  An AI investigator that answers with a source on every sentence. 
  OSINT · OSINT tool · AI investigator · AI agent · LLM · research assistant · citations · investigation · windows  
> **Status: v1.2.1.** The app is out — [download Legwork for Windows](https://awesomeosint.tools/legwork/).
## Why this exists
Every investigation starts the same way: twenty tabs, a notepad, and a question that keeps growing arms. The tabs win, the question loses.
## Why it is different
Search engines answer queries; Legwork answers questions. It reads the sources it finds and writes the answer with a citation on every sentence — so you can check it, not just trust it.
## The idea
- **One object.** A highlighter: the phrase a source backs up gets marked, and the source sits in the margin next to it.
- **One number.** How many public pages it read to write the answer.
- **Colour.** Ink `#121114` and paper `#F4F1EC`. Highlighter pink `#FF85C0` marks what is sourced, and the download.
- **The main feature.** No source, no sentence: every line of an answer carries the public pages it came from, single-source claims are left out, and gaps are stated instead of guessed.
## The demo on the page
The question types itself in, the page count runs up, and the answer is written one line at a time: the key phrase gets the highlighter, each sentence carries numbered source chips, and the sources line up as cards under the answer. The line that actually answers the question is held back, and the card offers the download instead. Three sample questions can be switched under the answer.

NukeRat 
  Post exploitation framework
    Documentation   ·
    Armory   ·
    Tutorial  
## About
NukeRat is a post exploitation framework for advanced Red Team operations, focused on exploiting modern and complex environments. 
## Features
| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Armory | +550 adapted BOF and .NET utilities |
| Communication | Custom C2 with external platforms (e.g. Telegram, Discord, etc.) |
| Runtime evasion | Indirect syscalls, stack spoofing, sleep mask, AMSI/ETW patch, etc. |
| Injections | Allocation modes: VirtualAlloc, section, and module stomping |
| LOTL | Living off the Land integration with +240 native Windows binaries (LOLBAS) |
| Static evasion | PE customization |
| Implants | Cross platform: Windows, Linux, macOS (ARM support) |
| Linux | Implants compatible with Linux BOFs |
| AI | Integration with agents (DeepSeek, local, etc.) |
| Reports | Executed commands, IOCs, and compromised hosts |
## Installation
> [!TIP]
> We recommend Kali Linux for NukeRat usage.
### Default
```bash
git clone https://github.com/nukeratframework/nukerat && cd nukerat && sudo bash install.sh all
```
### Docker
```bash
git clone https://github.com/nukeratframework/nukerat && cd nukerat && sudo bash install/docker/docker.sh all
```

For a quick start, see the 2 minute video tutorial teaching how to install NukeRat and create your first implant [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3dOcPoVXv30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3dOcPoVXv30).
*Click the image below to be redirected to the video tutorial.*
Or, if you prefer, see it through the documentation at [https://nukerat.com/docs/fast-setup](https://nukerat.com/docs/fast-setup).

AVault 
 A private place for your conversations. 
   Website  ·
   Download  ·
   Setup & configuration  ·

AVault is a free, open-source Android call recorder and encrypted audio vault. Keep recordings organised, find a conversation quickly, and choose what stays in your library.
> **Intended use:** lawful research, education and consent-based evaluation on devices and conversations you are authorised to record. AVault does not obtain consent or determine legal permission for you. The software is provided as-is, subject to the applicable license notices and non-excludable law. Read the [use, warranty and liability disclaimer](DISCLAIMER.md) before use.
The app uses **Shizuku** for system access without root. It installs on **Android 11 (API 30) and later**; recording support depends on your phone, Android version, audio source and calling app. Make a test recording before relying on your setup.
## A look inside

## Features
- **An organised library.** Search by contact, phone number or app, with filters for phone calls, supported calling apps and saved recordings.

- **Your retention rules.** Choose an auto-delete period or keep auto-delete off. Bookmarks exclude recordings from automatic cleanup.
- **Playback and sharing.** Listen inside the app or explicitly share an audio copy with another app.

top10.descricao_en: Learn cloud security by building it! An open-source homelab teaching Zero Trust, DevSecOps, IaC, and cloud architecture from the ground up.
top10.readme:
# Clouds Against Humanity
A small, cheap, locked-down DigitalOcean environment built with OpenTofu, applied by Spacelift, fed secrets by Doppler, and reachable only through Twingate. **No droplet has a single public inbound port open.** There is no VPN, no bastion host and no SSH on the internet.
It is a cloud extension of a homelab, and it exists to teach: this repository is the reference environment, and the lessons that use it live in the wiki.
> ### Start with the wiki
>
> **The wiki is the real point of this project.** Every lesson, flowchart, exercise and decision (including the ones that were wrong the first time) is written there; this repository is the environment those lessons use.
>
> - **[Wiki home](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki)**: the map of everything.
> - **[Start here if you are new](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Start-Here-If-You-Are-New)**: cloud, Terraform and zero trust from zero.
> - **[Why this exists](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Why-This-Exists)**: where this comes from and who it is for.
> - **[Reading order](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Reading-Order)**: the paths, with time estimates.
> - **[Contents](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Contents)**: every page once, grouped by theme, with what each is for.
> - **[Git from zero](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Git-From-Zero)**: if you have never used git.
> - **[Repository growth](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Repository-Growth)**: stars, forks and weekly work, drawn from GitHub data; the as-of date is printed in the picture, and stars measure attention, not use.
>
> **Who this assumes:** a basic power user. You know how a computer works, may have built or repaired one, and have set up a router and done basic networking. If you could work a help desk or a retail repair counter, you can start; if not, [IT 101 level material such as CompTIA A+ objectives](https://github.com/ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity/wiki/Start-Here-If-You-Are-New#where-zero-is) is the benchmark (not an endorsement).
>
> **Cost:** the reading and the exercises are free and always will be, and nothing here is sold. Hands-on work uses your own accounts and your provider's bill, nothing you spend goes to the maintainer, and you choose what you can afford to run.
